name.ja: Figure-rise Standard 魔人ブウ（純粋）

ja: Figure-rise Standard 魔人ブウ（純粋）がパッケージをリニューアルして登場！！
• 自制心がまったくない、悪そのものの存在、魔人ブウ（純粋）が待望のFigure-rise Standardに登場！
• 小さい体に凝縮された圧倒的なパワーを感じさせるマッシブな肉体造形。
• 魔人ブウ（純粋）の多彩な表情変化を再現したフェイスパーツは、通常・悪の2種類が付属！目元や口元の細かな変化、凶悪な表情を巧みに造形し、ハイクオリティな完成度！
• パーツ組立による表情形成技術で漆黒の中に光る赤い瞳を、プリントズレすることなく再現！
• 気功波やバニシングボールの巨大な気弾エフェクトも付属。同時発売のFigure-rise Standard超サイヤ人3孫悟空と組み合わせてドラゴンボールZの感動のラストバトルを再現可能！
• Figure-rise Standard「ドラゴンボール」シリーズを集めて、圧倒的バトルシーンを再現しよう！
en: Figure-rise Standard Majin Buu (pure) is now available with a renewed package! !
• Majin Buu (pure), an existence of evil itself with no self-control, appears in the long-awaited Figure-rise Standard!
• Massive body design that makes you feel overwhelming power concentrated in a small body.

• Two types of face parts are included: normal and evil, which reproduce the various expression changes of Majin Buu (pure)! Fine changes in the eyes and mouth, as well as the ferocious expression, are skillfully sculpted to create a high-quality figure!
• Using facial expression technology to assemble parts, red eyes glowing in jet black are reproduced without any print misalignment!

• Giant Qi bullet effects such as Qigong wave and Vanishing ball are also included. You can recreate the thrilling final battle of Dragon Ball Z by combining it with the simultaneously released Figure-rise Standard Super Saiyan 3 Son Goku!
• Collect Figure-rise Standard "Dragon Ball" series and recreate overwhelming battle scenes!
